title: Pure Lightray
summary: Lightray is a series of Level 6, 7, and 8 LIGHT boss monsters (Lightray Daedalus, Lightray Diabolos, Lightray Gearfried, Lightray Sorcerer, and Lightray Madoor) that Special Summon themselves from your hand for free once you have 3+ banished LIGHT monsters or 4–5+ LIGHT monsters in your GY! Use a Lightsworn LIGHT-milling engine (Raiden, Hand of the Lightsworn, Lumina, Lightsworn Summoner, Charge of the Light Brigade, and Solar Recharge) alongside Lightray Grepher to rapidly mill 4–5 LIGHT monsters with different names into your GY on Turn 1—letting you immediately flood the board with Lightray Diabolos, Lightray Daedalus, and Lightray Sorcerer!

allow.Raiden, Hand of the Lightsworn: Level 4 LIGHT Warrior Tuner that mills 2 cards during your Main Phase and 2 more during your End Phase—rapidly filling the GY with 4–5 LIGHT monsters to unlock Lightray Daedalus, Diabolos, and Gearfried while tuning into Level 8 Michael, the Arch-Lightsworn!
allow.Lumina, Lightsworn Summoner: Level 3 LIGHT Spellcaster that discards 1 LIGHT monster to revive Raiden from your GY and mill 3 more cards.
allow.Wulf, Lightsworn Beast: Level 4 LIGHT Beast-Warrior that automatically Special Summons itself whenever milled from the Deck by Raiden, Lumina, Charge of the Light Brigade, or Solar Recharge.
allow.Felis, Lightsworn Archer: Level 4 LIGHT Beast-Warrior Tuner that Special Summons itself when milled by a monster effect and tributes itself to destroy an opponent's monster and mill 3 more LIGHT cards.
allow.Charge of the Light Brigade: Mills the top 3 cards of your Deck for cost to add Raiden or Lumina from your Deck to your hand.
allow.Solar Recharge: Discards 1 Lightsworn monster to draw 2 cards and mill the top 2 cards of your Deck.
allow.Reinforcement of the Army: Limited to 1 in TCG: searches Lightray Grepher or Raiden, Hand of the Lightsworn.
allow.Michael, the Arch-Lightsworn: Level 7 LIGHT Dragon Synchro (1 Tuner + 1+ LIGHT non-Tuners) that pays 1000 LP to banish 1 card on the field and shuffles LIGHT monsters from your GY into the Deck if you accidentally mill over 5+ names.
allow.Minerva, the Exalted Lightsworn: Rank 4 LIGHT Fairy Xyz (2 Level 4 monsters: Raiden + Wulf/Lightray Grepher!) that detaches 1 material to mill 3 cards and draw 1 card for every Lightsworn milled—instantly fulfilling the 4–5 LIGHT GY requirement for every Lightray boss in your hand!
allow.Number 38: Hope Harbinger Dragon Titanic: Rank 8 LIGHT Dragon Xyz summoned using two Level 8 Lightray Gearfried.
allow.Chaos Angel: Level 10 Synchro boss that banishes an opposing card on summon and grants battle or effect immunity.

main: Lightray Diabolos

Signature Level 7 LIGHT Dragon boss (2800 ATK): Special Summons itself from your hand when you have 5 or more LIGHT monsters with different names in your GY; once per turn, banishes 1 LIGHT monster from your GY to reveal 1 Set card your opponent controls and place it on the top or bottom of their Deck!
Lightray Daedalus

Signature Level 7 LIGHT Sea Serpent boss (2600 ATK): Special Summons itself from your hand when you have 4 or more LIGHT monsters in your GY; once per turn targets 1 Field Spell and 2 other cards on the field and destroys them.
Lightray Sorcerer

Level 6 LIGHT Spellcaster boss (2300 ATK): Special Summons itself from your hand while 3 or more of your LIGHT monsters are banished; shuffles 1 banished LIGHT monster into the Deck to target and banish 1 face-up monster on the field!
Lightray Gearfried

Level 8 LIGHT Warrior boss (2800 ATK): Special Summons itself from your hand when you have 5 or more LIGHT monsters with different names in your GY, and negates Spell/Trap activations while all monsters you control are Warriors.
Lightray Grepher
Level 4 LIGHT Warrior starter: discards 1 Level 5 or higher LIGHT monster to Special Summon itself from hand, and discards 1 LIGHT monster to banish 1 LIGHT monster directly from your Deck.
Lightray Madoor
Level 6 LIGHT Spellcaster (1200 ATK / 3000 DEF): Special Summons itself from your hand if 3 or more of your LIGHT monsters are banished, and cannot be destroyed by battle once per turn.
Raiden, Hand of the Lightsworn
Level 4 LIGHT Warrior Tuner: mills 2 cards during your Main Phase and 2 during your End Phase to rapidly stock your GY with 4–5 LIGHT monsters for Lightray Daedalus and Lightray Diabolos.
Lumina, Lightsworn Summoner
Level 3 LIGHT Spellcaster: discards 1 LIGHT monster to revive Raiden from your GY, providing another LIGHT name and 2+ more mills.
Wulf, Lightsworn Beast
Level 4 LIGHT Beast-Warrior (2100 ATK): Special Summons itself whenever milled by Raiden, Minerva, Charge, or Solar Recharge, pairing with Raiden or Lightray Grepher to Xyz Summon Minerva!
Felis, Lightsworn Archer
Level 4 LIGHT Beast-Warrior Tuner: Special Summons itself when milled by Raiden or Minerva and tributes itself to pop a monster and mill 3 more LIGHT cards.
Charge of the Light Brigade
Mills 3 cards for cost and searches Raiden or Lumina—giving you 3 LIGHT monsters in the GY before you even Normal Summon!
Solar Recharge
Discards Wulf, Felis, or Lumina to draw 2 cards and mill 2 cards, fueling your GY with LIGHT names while digging for Lightray bosses.
Reinforcement of the Army
Limited to 1 in TCG: searches Lightray Grepher or Raiden, Hand of the Lightsworn.
extra: Rank 4 LIGHT Fairy Xyz (2 Level 4 monsters: Lightray Grepher, Raiden, Wulf, or Felis): detaches 1 material to mill 3 cards and draw up to 3 cards, then mills 3 more and destroys up to 3 cards when destroyed!
Level 7 LIGHT Dragon Synchro (Raiden + Lumina): pays 1000 LP to banish any card on the field and recycles LIGHT monsters from GY to gain LP.
Number 38: Hope Harbinger Dragon Titanic Galaxy
Rank 8 LIGHT Dragon Xyz made with two Level 8 Lightray Gearfried.
Link-4: gains ATK based on Link material and banishes Link Monsters from GY to destroy opponent's cards without response.
Level 10 Synchro: can be Synchro Summoned using LIGHT or DARK monsters without Tuners; banishes 1 card on field and gives protection.
